summary: Plan research designs, sampling, surveys and analysis with practical exercises. Explore the research methodology course and find your next step.
lede: Research methodology connects a study question to a suitable design, sampling plan, data collection and analysis. For researchers, analysts and programme professionals, this training supports planning or reviewing applied studies by comparing quantitative and qualitative designs, drafting surveys or interview guides, and summarising evidence in Excel or through thematic coding.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, conduct, commission or review applied research and need to connect study questions with defensible methods and usable findings.
modules: Research Questions and the Research Onion
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a workplace, programme or academic research question is useful. No programming is required; exercises use Excel for introductory survey summaries.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
